nom: Thayers Alcohol-Free Witch Hazel Facial Toner

segments.oily: Oily-skin reviewers are largely positive, describing less shine, smaller-looking pores and, for some, fewer breakouts and less redness; one reviewer with mostly oily skin found the mattifying effect real but not worth it unless skin is very oily, since it did little for her drier patches.
segments.dry: Dry-skin reviewers are split: some call it a lifesaver that calms and rehydrates dry, flaky or thin skin, while others, including one after a recent reformulation, say it leaves their skin tighter and drier and recommend following with moisturizer.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers, including two who describe it as oily-combination, say it is gentle and balancing; one calls it the only toner that has never dried out her skin.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are overwhelmingly positive, particularly with the unscented version, repeatedly reporting no irritation, burning or breakouts even on reactive or fragrance-averse skin; one reviewer, however, reports her face turning red and hot right after use.

concerns.dehydration: Many reviewers, including several with dry or combination skin, say it does not dry out their skin and even find it hydrating; but a comparable number, including two after a recent reformulation, report increased tightness or dryness with regular use, and a couple recommend following with moisturizer or reserving it for warmer months.
concerns.redness: Most reviewers who mention redness say it calms it, including one whose facial redness dropped significantly within a week and another who saw less redness after four days; one reviewer, by contrast, reports her face turning red and hot immediately after use.
concerns.blemishes: The large majority of reviewers with acne-prone skin report fewer or no new breakouts, several describing stubborn or old breakouts finally clearing within one to a few weeks; one reviewer, by contrast, says it made her break out on her face and now uses it on her legs instead.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers dealing with oiliness consistently report it helps control shine and keeps oil production in check through the day, including one who says her face stays relatively oil-free by morning; a couple pair the mattifying effect with a caveat that it can be a little drying if used often.
concerns.spots: Two reviewers with acne-related marks say post-breakout hyperpigmentation and scarring fade faster with regular use; no reviewer reports new spots or discoloration.

aspects.libelle: Scent can be off-putting or too strong for some

extraits.texte: After immidiate use of this product, my face would always turn really red and hot, which was very uncomfortable. Not worth it.

extraits.titre: Good Toner for Really Oily Skin
extraits.texte: If you have really oily skin, this is a great toner because of the astringent nature of the witch hazel and smells nice because of the rose water. The rose water provides a soothing effect but is not quite enough for the dry spots on my skin. In all honesty, unless you have unmanageably oily skin and need an additional step in your routine to keep your face more matte throughout the day, it is okay to skip this.

I've been using witch hazel for decades and this new formula is not as good as their previous one. My skin does not feel as soft and feels more dry, also there is no fragrance of witch hazel at all and the rose smells different too. . I bought another brand online and I can't wait for it to arrive. I will be dumping this one out as soon as it gets here. Very disappointed that Thayer's sold out to L'Oreal and they changed all their witch hazel products.

Oily female here with acne prone to hyperpigmentation and noticeable pores/ blackheads around chin and nose. I never used a toner until this one and I'm glad that for my skin care journey this was my first to try. After cleansing in the shower this toner sets my skin for serums, sleep masks, or daily moisturizers. My pores in select places around my face have gotten smaller and my skin has a constantly dewy/healthy appearance. Furthermore any hyperpigmentation I get from acne breakouts fade much faster than without this product. Affordable, effective, and environmentally conscious.

extraits.titre: I will never use anything else!
extraits.texte: I am an Asian woman in my early 30's with oily skin and definitely some redness due to trying to control the oil. I've never been able to wear make up (high end, non-comedogenic) consistently because it would always cause more breakouts. I've done prescription acne treatments in my 20's, and while my cystic acne is gone, I still get the fun little ones around my jaw/chin and lips. I've been using Clarins products for the last 3-4 years because I love the quality and the smell. Started reading about this super cheap witch hazel alternative and decided to give it a try. When I tell you this stuff was a game changer, believe it! Within the first week of use, I was able to wear make up all day every day without additional breakouts. It has cut down the oil on my face, has healed previous pimples flawlessly, and has significantly reduced the redness because of how anti-inflammatory and gentle it is on the skin. As a woman of color who was on the verge of accepting that I'd just have acne til the day I die, I could not recommend this product enough. For all my POC girlies with oily skin - GET THIS STUFF!!!

I have very sensitive skin that reacts violently to high-end chemically fragranced luxury brands. This is the only brand my loves - the unscented version. Cleans, refreshes and moisturizes. My all in one. I don't use serums and cream moisturizers, other than SPF. No clogged pores, breakouts. Keeping it simple. My skin is happy and it glows! I hope Ulta continues to keep this product on their shelves, though it appears they are gradually phasing thisout in favor of the luxury brands.

Thayers Natural Remedies Witch Hazel Aloe Vera Facial Toner, in its generous 355ml size, has become a must-have for my skincare routine. Its natural formula, featuring witch hazel and aloe vera, provides soothing relief to my dry skin. This toner not only cleanses and refreshes but also reduces redness and inflammation. It's a cost-effective choice, and its gentle floral scent adds a touch of luxury to my daily routine. In sum, if you're looking for a budget-friendly, skin-loving toner that helps combat dryness, this one is a winner.
